hero.subtitle: RUAH ELPIS is a Christian non-profit foundation dedicated to improving health and welfare for the medically vulnerable through health education and community sports programs.

mission.title: Standing beside the marginalized,
mission.desc: RUAH ELPIS supports health and independence for women, minorities, the elderly, and children from broken homes through medical education and community sport programs.

cards.title: RUAH · Breath / Life
cards.desc: We build the foundation for self-reliance by cultivating health literacy so people can care for themselves and their families.

cards.title: ELPIS · Hope / Expectation
cards.desc: Beyond physical health, we restore positive expectations for tomorrow through mental wellness care.

cards.title: COMMUNITY · Solidarity / Love
cards.desc: Through sports programs, we help the marginalized form peer groups and engage healthily with society.

items.title: Health Literacy Education
items.desc: We provide basic health knowledge, preventive medicine, and healthy lifestyle education to medically underserved communities.

items.title: Active Community Sports
items.desc: Peer-group sports programs promote physical health while building social connections and mental wellness through community engagement.

items.title: Integrated Welfare Safety Net
items.desc: Tailored welfare programs for women, the elderly, and children from broken homes, placing individual dignity and recovery at the center.

items.title: Mind & Breath Counseling
items.desc: We alleviate isolation and support emotional stability through community relationship building, counseling referrals, and small group activities.

about.title: The story
about.body1: RUAH is a Hebrew word meaning "spirit", "wind", and "breath". ELPIS is a Greek word for "hope" and "expectation".
about.body2: Like the union of these two words, we seek to share the breath of life and hope with our marginalized neighbors — creating real change through health education and community programs.

Your Care,

actionTiers.desc: RUAH ELPIS publishes full transparency on how every contribution is used. Choose how you want to participate.

monthly.label: Health Self-Care
monthly.value: Monthly support to produce health materials and provide one child with a sustainable self-care hygiene kit every month.

monthly.label: Mind Care
monthly.value: Monthly matching of one marginalized youth with a professional mentoring program at the Mind & Breath Counseling Center.

monthly.label: Sports Community
monthly.value: Monthly funding of regular training sessions and sports welfare infrastructure for one children's football team.

oneoff.label: Health Field
oneoff.value: A one-time contribution delivers a special hygiene package to one health education class in an underserved village in Patna, India.

oneoff.label: Emergency Care
oneoff.value: A one-time contribution provides a 4-session intensive mind healing solution for a youth in urgent emotional distress.

oneoff.label: Community Fest
oneoff.value: A one-time contribution funds an integrated community sports friendship tournament and provides full equipment for all participants.
